svg.aria-label: lockhttp: an agent (Claude Code, in a lea container) fetches a page of pkg.go.dev, a trusted host, and the gate lets the GET through at once. It then POSTs a build report to hooks.example.net, an unknown host: the gate holds it, and a question shows in lox run, in the human's own terminal. The human presses d to read the whole masked screen (the author's email shows as j***(23)), then n; the agent gets a 403 E_DENIED, denied on the hub, and the gate's audit records both decisions.
